instrument: Resident litigation challenging the Stratos approvals
summary: Residents have sued officials over the approval of the Stratos project. This is the first legal challenge to a data center approval recorded in the register.
notes: Political context recorded separately: the Senate President who championed the approvals lost his primary on June 23, 2026 after more than twenty years in the legislature. Polling reported a shift from roughly seven in ten voters saying benefits did not outweigh resource costs in May to 60% opposition by late June, with Republican opposition rising from 36% to 49%.
confidence_note: Relayed; no filing has been read. Case number unknown. Polling figures are from reporting and have not been traced to the underlying surveys.
